label: Magic Item
description: Create a permanent magic item. The work needs a full workshop, the listed silver, and a successful Magic check at the end.

label: Spell Research
description: Research a new spell or recover a lost one. Each advance is a week of study with a teacher or text.

label: Magic Working
description: Raise a lasting magical work, such as a ward, a road, or a curse. The source sets the target by the scale of the working.

label: Faction Turn
description: Resolve one faction turn: assets, orders, and upkeep. The target is the number of faction actions the table agrees to resolve.
